scope_note: PASS is within the declared experimental scope (real 1000G chr22/chr1 prefixes, 5 splits, k=10); it does not establish broader generalization or preprocessing equivalence.

gt_provenance.details: real 1000G study-inclusion labels on a disjoint 5-role split; simulated phenotype only for the GWAS-power row

score_normalization.details: membership score is a plain norm; no recovered-rank divisor; other denominators reference-based

result_existence.details: chr22/chr1/s62/s63/s64/s65/s66 JSONs exist; every summary number re-verified against them (322 table values checked in the final pass)

dead_code.details: all metric functions called and present in the JSON; common.stratified_permutation_auroc is unused (s61 implements its own permutation test) — harmless

scope.details: 2 chromosomes x 5 seeds; one k=10; q=16 only in the chr22 saturation cell; chr replication reuses subjects; no comprehensive/robust wording
